explanation: IBRANCE is FDA-approved only for HR+/HER2-negative disease in combination with an AI, fulvestrant, or inavolisib+fulvestrant. No evidence supports approval with 'trastuzumab-based therapy,' which targets HER2-positive disease and contradicts the drug's HER2-negative indication.
suggested_rewrite: Ibrance (palbociclib) combined with an aromatase inhibitor, fulvestrant, or inavolisib plus fulvestrant is FDA-approved across defined HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer populations.
